first.rationale: Activation messaging (memory_91) directly addresses the 6% QoQ activation decline and has a proven track record of improving week-one engagement and nudging first meaningful actions. This is the highest-leverage response to the immediate activation drop. While promotional pricing could defend against SMB churn from competitor entry, activation messaging addresses root product engagement issues that affect all segments and compounds with onboarding improvements (memory_86, memory_31). Referral incentives are better suited for growth acceleration, not recovery. Enterprise sales assist doesn't address the broad-based activation decline. Verification of memory_91 confirms the activation messaging mechanism and effect size; memory_86 confirmation ensures we understand onboarding completion dynamics to coordinate any downstream sequencing. Standard experiment scale allows rapid learning without overcommitting resources, and leaves room to pivot if competitor pressure intensifies.
